description: KCATA Bus Stops is a dataset listed in City of Kansas City open data portal (data.kcmo.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Kansas City. List of KCATA Bus Stops as of November 2024. Data includes the stop ID, location, and routes services as well as other stop information like whether a bench is installed at the location. This data may be inaccurate or incomplete. Coverage: Kansas City, Missouri. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are kcata, transportation, infrastructure, buses. The table has 19 columns. Attribution on the portal: Kansas City Area Transit Authority. The portal shows 2026-02-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-kcmo-org-portal.
